svg.text: Seed3 socket (jumper ends in the right wall), seen from INSIDE, USB-C end on your LEFT
PG-1 wiring, page 2 of 10: Carrier board -> Seed3: the 6 signal jumpers
Plug the jumpers onto the board's header BEFORE the board goes in the box (the names are printed on the board's face side). The other ends go in the
Steps (the number is on the wire):
board 'seed3 + 9v' header: pin 'scl' (5th from the left)
-> Seed3 socket place 12 (top row) (jumper: I2C clock)
board 'seed3 + 9v' header: pin 'sda' (6th from the left)
-> Seed3 socket place 13 (top row) (jumper: I2C data)
board 'seed3 + 9v' header: pin 'sck' (7th from the left)
board 'seed3 + 9v' header: pin 'fs' (8th from the left)
board 'seed3 + 9v' header: pin 'tx' (9th from the left)
board 'seed3 + 9v' header: pin 'rx' (last on the right)
